cases.title: Claude sonnet summarizes a maintenance paragraph in one sentence
cases.prompt:
Summarize the following paragraph in exactly one sentence:

The maintenance plan for cooling water pump P-101 starts with a weekly visual inspection of seals and couplings. Vibration levels are measured every month and compared against the baseline recorded at commissioning. Bearing lubrication is performed every three months using the grease specified by the manufacturer. Every six months, the motor insulation resistance is tested and alignment is verified with a laser tool. A full overhaul, including impeller and wear ring replacement, is scheduled every four years or after 30,000 running hours. All findings are logged in the CMMS so that trends can trigger corrective work before a failure occurs.
